head: 5cd6b7534966ce9694512a40186504d25200472d
reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (independent reviewer for the F20 delivery session)
scope: The full diff main..f20-ambiguous-deferred-targets at 5cd6b7534 and the design change 99d1c2997 on engineering. The review probed the new pf beside the base build: deferred directives at entry level, in composed content and under a copy's subst, naming shared and container-carried fragments; deferred links and dispatches; the selection refactor's resolved path; and the remedy for plain-path, titled and ? entries with and without --pick. Excluded as speculative, with no issue filed: whether each composed copy is counted on its own for alternatives (unverified, and F19's area).
criteria: AC1, AC4: the deferred-target fixtures pass. AC2: make check. AC3: the remedy tests. AC3 failed under finding 1.
validation: Targeted pytest over test_selection.py and test_cli.py passed; make check exited 0 at 5cd6b7534 (corpus 639 of 639).

findings.description: A ? entry run with --pick naming no alternative got the title remedy, because entry() removed ? from the tags, so the rerun the run accepts was not named.
The design's Activation bullet said a deferring run asserts only that the target exists, contradicting the new Deferred composition rule.
The unresolved docstring restated the pick rule entry owns, and resolved did not state when the rerun remedy applies.

head: eb0e788ce15974eb96ca6ac20c52943993cb5eea
reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (independent reviewer for the F20 delivery session)
scope: The fixes 5cd6b7534..eb0e788ce and the design commit 676ddf951, against the three findings they fix. 23 entry and --pick cases were compared byte for byte with the pre-fix build: bundle names and qualifiers, published deferral titles, ? dispatches, deferrals to stub targets, reselection and stated_pick. Only the two intended remedy cases differ. Excluded, with no issue filed: --pick 'epic, task' beside a ? entry keeps the title remedy, which the run accepts and which predates the branch; a --pick name reaching other documents' deferrals as a run name predates the branch.
criteria: AC3 holds for the bad-pick case. AC1, AC2 and AC4 are unchanged.
validation: Targeted pytest over test_cli, test_selection, test_entry_presets, test_deferred_presets, test_stub_presets and test_dispatch_variants passed; make check exited 0 at eb0e788ce.

findings.description: The design's The agent's pick bullet and three pick fixture descriptions said --pick stands where ? stands, while entry keeps ? beside the pick.

head: a4da59ae377fcb108caf65d7f569669d6bbf7575
reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 (independent reviewer for the F20 delivery session)
scope: The folded #796 change eb0e788ce..a4da59ae3: selection ahead of governing in traverse, its fixture, the wording fixes and the documents. Probes against the eb0e788ce build covered a substituted reference in a later round, a missing fragment with two picks, a plain link with two picks, and a refusal in another document against a missing fragment. Accepted as the stated rule: a fragment's defect is reported ahead of preset failures and other documents' refusals, deterministic either way.
criteria: AC5: the fragment-before-pick fixture passes. AC1-AC4 are unchanged.
validation: make check exited 0 at a4da59ae3 (2245 tests, harness 1079, corpus 640 of 640).

findings.description: docs/references.md and the fixture description gave a wrong reason (a pick counted on the section the fragment names); the order is the reason.
The docs and the traverse docstring called ordinary presets picks, and the docstring's last clause narrowed the rule to the reference's own title.
